verdict.label: REAL_RUNTIME_BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_RECONSTRUCTION
verdict.one_line: Real HSR 4.4.54 content cannot yet produce a single BattleState transition, because the behavior reconstruction deliberately refuses 29,086 operation nodes and has recovered no runtime execution semantics for any of them; zero of 620 canonical skills is executable.
why_C: content_support binding_level_distribution: CONTENT_ACTION_EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE = 0 and REFERENCE_SETTLEMENT_BOUND = 0. All 620 rows are STATIC_ONLY (96), BEHAVIOR_ROOT_BOUND (200) or FULL_ACTION_REPRESENTED (324) and none is executable.
The compiler refuses 29086 operation nodes with BEHAVIOR_AFFECTING_NODE_NOT_COMPILED and enforces REJECT_NOT_NOOP, so a rejected record cannot be promoted piecewise.
The M12 census finds ACTION_A_CURRENTLY_CLOSED = 0 and ACTION_B_WAIT_ONLY = 0 across all 324 closure-censused rows; the minimum residual is still 1 blocker class (DAMAGE_PACKET) for the 5 best rows.

The single skill with a recovered semantic chain (Natasha Skill02, heal) reaches a request boundary and deliberately performs no mutation because the positive HealData event consumer is unrecovered. Four explicit dependencies remain in that bounded slice alone.

DamageByAttackProperty runtime dispatch is PARTIAL_RESOLUTION - TARGET_UNRESOLVED: the PGOOHIHKHNJ +0x120 slot owner and its +0x2D8 writer are UNKNOWN, and the SPHitRatio evidence artifact is itself BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE with the explicit instruction not to re-enter SOL on it.

TriggerAbility execution_readiness is NO with expected_new_executable_coverage 0; astra_reverse_master states full_native_behavior_reconstruction_complete false and native_reconstruction_status INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE_AND_CONTENT_BLOCKED.
Monster runtime admission is UNKNOWN and Stage wave advance is BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE_AND_GRAPH_CONTENT, so no non-avatar content can fill the gap either.
verdict.why_not_D: Option D presupposes that content is sufficient and only the state model is missing. Content is demonstrably not sufficient (0 executable skills, 29086 refused nodes, no cross-ability identity, no damage dispatch). D-type work is also unfinished - TerraBattleState is a 61-empty-store shell, energy/DOT/summons/weakness/shields have no representation, DecisionPoint does not exist, and legal_actions only classifies - and it will have to be done, but it is not the binding constraint: there is currently no content to execute, so building the state model first would create a runtime with nothing to run.
verdict.why_not_A_or_B: A and B require that a bounded set of fixes unlocks the first real action. No bounded fix set exists: the blocker set spans content extraction (11 monster sequence IDs, direct-HP node mapping, DynamicFloat operands, the +0x120 dispatch), semantic mapping (TriggerAbility activation, AI precedence, wave advance, terminal predicates), runtime primitives (positive heal consumer, event trigger engine) and evidence (0 golden, 0 native trace, empty oracle ledger). The smallest honest slice (Natasha heal) needs four named dependencies and still cannot mutate state.
verdict.why_not_E: The current foundations do not conflict with the goal. The evidence-gated layering, the frozen evidence vocabulary, the deterministic hash/clone/replay infrastructure and the two complete DFS search engines are all reusable and correct for the original goal. This is a completeness gap, not an architectural contradiction. The consistent finding across every module is 'denied, not wrong'.
verdict.secondary_co_blocker_for_the_record: REAL_RUNTIME_BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_STATE_MODEL is also true and will become primary once reconstruction succeeds. It is recorded here as the next-in-line blocker, not as the current verdict.
